         COUNT(*) AS rentals
  FROM rental
  GROUP BY 1
),
diff AS (
  SELECT month_utc,
         rentals,
         rentals - LAG(rentals) OVER (ORDER BY month_utc) AS increase
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT to_char(month_utc, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_utc,
       increase
FROM diff
WHERE increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 1;
